onboarding.title: Sync your chats across devices
onboarding.description: Your conversations sync through your iCloud Drive, end-to-end encrypted.
onboarding.explainer: ChatShell can keep your conversation history consistent on every device you own, using the iCloud Drive folder you already have. The cloud copy is encrypted with a key that never leaves your devices.
onboarding.pointEncrypted: Snapshots and attachments travel as ciphertext; the cloud provider sees only encrypted data.
onboarding.pointOffDevice: Turn this off any time in Settings — your other devices keep syncing.
onboarding.passphraseGuidance: Write it down or store it in a password manager. It is not recoverable from this app.
onboarding.confirmSaved: I saved this passphrase somewhere safe
onboarding.recoveryEducation: This phrase unlocks your cloud history on new devices. If you lose it, enrolled devices keep working, but the cloud backup cannot be restored anywhere new.
onboarding.enabled: Sync enabled — encrypted and running in the background
onboarding.error: Failed to set up sync encryption
onboarding.joinExplainer: A synced history already exists on this account. Enter its sync passphrase to join — your consent to sync still applies.
onboarding.joined: Sync joined — pulling your cloud history

errors.wrongPassphrase: That passphrase doesn't match. Check the phrase you saved when sync was first enabled.
errors.corruptData: The synced data in iCloud Drive appears damaged or was written by a newer version of ChatShell. Update the app on every device and try again.
errors.failed: That didn't work. Check your connection to iCloud Drive and try again.

locked.banner: Cloud sync is waiting for your sync passphrase. Everything on this device keeps working.
locked.dialogDescription: Enter the sync passphrase you saved when sync was first enabled. It unwraps the encryption key for your cloud history.
locked.unlocked: Sync unlocked — pulling your cloud history

settings.title: Cloud sync
settings.description: Encrypted conversation sync through iCloud Drive (ADR: transport encryption). The cloud copy is unreadable without a key held on your devices.
settings.rotateDescription: For suspected compromise or a lost device. New snapshots and attachments are protected from any holder of the old key; data written before the rotation stays readable to them. Enter your sync passphrase to confirm.
settings.deleteDescription: This removes the encrypted snapshot and attachment store from iCloud Drive. Your other devices stop receiving updates. Data on this device is untouched. This cannot be undone.
